sections.name: Header
sections.description: Sticky top nav with crystal glassmorphism effect. Logo on left, Minimalist nav links on right.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Massive Schibsted Grotesk typography asserting authority. Text: 'Neurological Image Analysis.' Subtext in Geist Mono. Focus on the drag-and-drop zone.

sections.name: Upload Zone
sections.description: A premium dropzone taking up significant real-estate. Border-dashed, subtle gray background, micro-interactions on drag hover. Includes 'or select from sample gallery' link.

sections.name: Sample Gallery
sections.description: Bento-grid of 4 sample MRIs (Glioma, Meningioma, Pituitary, Normal). Clicking one auto-fills the upload zone and starts analysis.

sections.name: Analysis View (Active State)
sections.description: Split screen or modal overlay. Left: The scanned image with a 'scanning' overlay animation. Right: The Editorial Medical Report (RAG response) typed out in real-time. Tumor status highlighted in Accent Red/Green.

sections.name: Disclaimer
sections.description: Footer area with clinical mono-spaced text stating this is an AI tool and not medical advice.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Schibsted Grotesk (or Hanken Grotesk/Bricolage Grotesque) for headings and Geist Mono (or JetBrains Mono) for body text via Google Fonts/Fontsource.
Implement the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' aesthetic: Use absolute stark white background, no gradients. Rely heavily on 1px borders (#E5E5E5) and strict grid alignment.
The UI must feel like a high-end medical journal or an elite developer tool. DO NOT use rounded corners (use rounded-none everywhere, including buttons and cards).
For the drag-and-drop zone, implement a smooth Framer Motion transition for the 'drag active' state.
When rejecting a non-MRI image, display a clean, high-contrast toast or inline error message with the 'crumpled paper' image as a visual reference of what not to upload.
When displaying the RAG analysis, format it like a medical report using mono fonts for labels (e.g., 'DIAGNOSIS:', 'CONFIDENCE:') and grotesque for the prose.
